channel.title: Communication
channel.description: Research notes and everyday observations by Liangbin Zhao.

item.title: Initializing Receive Probabilities for the BI-AWGN Channel
item.description: Initializing receive probabilities for the BI-AWGN channel, with a detailed derivation of log-likelihood ratios and their expressions under different signal-to-noise ratio conventions.

item.title: Channel Equalization Algorithms
item.description: An introduction to classical adaptive channel-equalization methods, including Sato, constant-modulus (CMA), multimodulus (MMA), decision-directed (DD), modified CMA (MCMA), and CADAMA algorithms.

item.title: Timing Synchronization Algorithms
item.description: Frequency-domain matched filtering with O&M timing synchronization, followed by the properties, error formula, and frequency-offset behavior of the Gardner detector.

item.title: Matched Filtering with Polyphase Filters
item.description: Derivations and implementation notes for variable-rate pulse shaping and high-speed parallel matched filters.
